epistemic_gaps: This is a single case report, which cannot establish general causation or be generalized to a wider population.

Elevated serum creatinine is a surrogate marker and does not definitively prove kidney damage or 'destruction'. Creatine supplementation can naturally increase creatinine levels without indicating kidney dysfunction.
The study design (case report) cannot support the broad causal claim made in the headline.

contradictions.point: Numerous randomized controlled trials and meta-analyses have shown that creatine supplementation, at recommended doses, does not adversely affect kidney function in healthy individuals.
contradictions.source: Multiple scientific reviews and studies on creatine safety
